description: Ecoshape and public flood-defence partners provide an area representation indicating beach, construction, beach clubs, nourishments and dune-valley portions. The source explicitly preserves a beach definition of +3 metres NAP and indicates dune-valley portions containing at least one NaN value. Coverage: 2015-05/2018-03. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Missing values are preserved as a source descriptor and were not interpreted as measured zeroes. Detailed class fields, grid spacing and classification accuracy are unstated. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Hondsbossche collection identifies these dune systems as primary flood defence created with sand nourishment. Simulation use concerns their monitored geometry and morphological development.
